about.title: About me
about.shortBio: My name is {fullname}, or simply {name} to those who know me. I'm a Full-Stack Developer based in Madagascar.
about.fullBio: I like taking a real need from a team or a client and turning it into something that works. I care about readable code, fixing the actual cause of a problem, and leaving things easier to maintain than I found them.
about.summary: I'm comfortable on both sides of an application: frontend, backend, APIs and the database underneath. JavaScript/TypeScript and PHP are where I'm strongest, with Python as a useful extra.

experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.subtitle: Selected roles, responsibilities and contributions across my professional experience.

neoshore-frontend-developer.summary: Worked on TheGreenshot's web app: new frontend features, bug fixes, and ongoing maintenance of its Progressive Web App (PWA).
responsibilities: Built and improved Vue.js frontend features based on product requirements and development tickets.
Fixed bugs and made the app more stable and easier to use.
Tested new features and fixes before delivery.
Independently handled the ongoing maintenance of the application's PWA component, built with Ionic and Capacitor.
Worked in an Agile team: tickets, regular communication, small iterations.
Contributed to approximately 75% of the planned features and bug fixes, alongside testing and maintenance.
neoshore-frontend-developer.achievement: of the planned features and bug fixes I contributed to

kontiki-full-stack-developer.summary: Built internal tools to automate marketing campaigns: generating mini-sites and collecting campaign data in one place.
responsibilities: Built a Laravel platform that generates blog-style campaign mini-sites from templates and form data, with code export and deployment to a server.
Developed a Nuxt.js app, similar to Google Sheets, to browse and manage the campaign data we pulled from APIs.
Wrote Python/FastAPI services that collect and process campaign data automatically.
Designed and managed the relational databases behind these apps.
Used Docker to standardize development environments and facilitate platform deployment.
kontiki-full-stack-developer.achievement: estimated improvement in internal team efficiency

kontiki-internship.summary: Worked on internal apps and web services, on both frontend and backend, to connect the company's tools and make them more useful.
responsibilities: Built frontend and backend features for internal apps.
Wrote web services and APIs to connect existing tools and add new features to them.
Worked on several projects: new features, bug fixes and improvements to internal tools.
Helped design and manage the databases so data stayed consistent.

dgi-php-internship.summary: Worked on a platform that makes each taxpayer's minimum tax amount easier to look up and manage.
responsibilities: Designed and built features for managing and looking up tax information.
Built a REST API that returns the minimum tax amount due for each taxpayer.
Helped design the database and manage the tax data.
Structured the application following Laravel conventions.

projects.title: Projects & Achievements
projects.subtitle: A few projects from work and internships.

campaign-minisite-generator.title: Automated Campaign Mini-site Generator
campaign-minisite-generator.description: A Laravel platform that generates blog-style campaign mini-sites from reusable templates and form data. The code can be exported or deployed straight to a server.
campaign-minisite-generator.problem: Each campaign required a developer to create and deploy its mini-site manually, which took time and made the process repetitive.
campaign-minisite-generator.solution: Pick a template, fill in a form, and the mini-site is generated. Export the code or deploy it to a server, no developer needed.

campaign-data-dashboard.title: Campaign Data Management Dashboard
campaign-data-dashboard.description: A Nuxt.js app, built like a spreadsheet, for managing and visualizing the marketing campaign data collected through APIs.
campaign-data-dashboard.problem: Campaign data came from several sources and there was no single place to view and manage it.
campaign-data-dashboard.solution: A spreadsheet-style interface that anyone familiar with Excel or Google Sheets can pick up quickly, to organize and visualize the data.

tax-minimum-payment-platform.title: Minimum Tax Payment Information Platform
tax-minimum-payment-platform.description: A platform for managing minimum tax payment information, with a REST API that returns the amount each taxpayer owes.
tax-minimum-payment-platform.problem: Looking up a taxpayer's minimum tax payment took more effort than it should.
tax-minimum-payment-platform.solution: A Laravel platform with a REST API and PostgreSQL database integration.

neoshore-vuejs-application.title: TheGreenshot Web Application
neoshore-vuejs-application.description: Frontend work in Vue.js and TypeScript: new features, bug fixes, testing, and maintenance of the app's Ionic/Capacitor PWA.
neoshore-vuejs-application.problem: The app needed steady frontend work and bug fixing to stay reliable and pleasant to use.
neoshore-vuejs-application.solution: Delivered iterative frontend improvements, validated features and fixes, and looked after the PWA on my own, inside an Agile team.

automated-campaign-data-processing.title: Automated Campaign Data Collection and Processing
automated-campaign-data-processing.description: Python/FastAPI services that collect and process marketing campaign data automatically.
automated-campaign-data-processing.problem: Collecting campaign data meant a lot of repetitive manual work.
automated-campaign-data-processing.solution: I built backend services with Python and FastAPI to automate the collection and processing.
